strategies.title: Habit strategies
strategies.lead: Fourteen ways that help you build good and leave bad.
strategies.remindHint: At most one reminder a week, on Saturday; turn it off any time.

start-tiny.idea: Start with an amount so small it needs no effort.
start-tiny.example: Example: two minutes of Quran instead of a whole juz.

anchor-prayer.idea: Place the habit after a set prayer, so the prayer reminds you of it.
anchor-prayer.example: Example: the adhkar right after the Fajr prayer.

if-then.idea: Decide in advance what you will do when the moment comes.
if-then.example: Example: if I miss my wird, then I will read one page before sleep.

prepare-place.idea: Set out what the habit needs before its time.
prepare-place.example: Example: the mushaf on the desk, the prayer mat laid out.

block-sin.idea: Keep the means of the sin out of reach, and make the way to it long.
block-sin.example: Example: delete the app, and leave the phone outside the room at night.

never-twice.idea: If you miss the habit one day, do not miss it a second day.
never-twice.example: Example: after a missed day, start your day with its smallest amount.

make-up.idea: What you missed yesterday can be made up until Dhuhr the next day.
make-up.example: Example: you missed your night wird, so read it in the forenoon.

bundle.idea: Pair the habit with something you enjoy and look forward to.
bundle.example: Example: tasbih on your way to work.

season.idea: Seasons of good help a start; hearts are more willing in them.
season.example: Example: begin fasting Mondays and Thursdays in Shaban.

know-weak.idea: Notice the time, place and state in which you weaken.
know-weak.example: Example: after midnight, when you are alone.

ride-wave.idea: An urge rises and then falls; hold on for a few minutes.
ride-wave.example: Example: make wudu, or change your place for ten minutes.

follow-good.idea: If you slip, repent, and follow it with a good deed at once.
follow-good.example: Example: a small charity or two rakahs after the slip.

company.idea: Keep company that helps you to good, and look in on your friends.
company.example: Example: agree with a friend on a shared wird.

self-review.idea: Take a minute each evening: what did you keep, and what did you miss?
self-review.example: Example: a short review before sleep.
